name: Sovereign Workstation Codespace (Dedicated Ephemeral Exit Node)
description: Linux codespace for the sovereign-workstation stack. Joins the tailnet automatically on start (TS_AUTHKEY secret) and comes up as a dedicated EPHEMERAL Tailscale exit node serving deployed sovereign workstations -- no manual 'tailscale up'. (Codespaces cannot run Windows containers; the Windows SovereignUser/RDP posture is exercised by the GitHub Actions workflow on windows-latest.)
